item.title: Kim Min-seok Broadens Steps Toward Party Leadership Challenge, Lunches with 9 New Regional Government Heads (당대표 도전 보폭 넓히는 김민석, 새 광역단체장 9명과 오찬)
item.description:
As Democratic Party of Korea leader Jung Cheong-rae faces pressure from inside and outside the party to resign and not run in the national convention due to responsibility for the June 3 local election defeat, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil, both mentioned as party leadership contenders, are expanding their moves targeting the national convention. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 6·3 지방선거 패배 책임론으로 당 안팎에서 대표 사퇴와 전당대회 불출마 압박을 받는 가운데, 당권 주자로 거론되는 김민석 국무총리와 송영길 의원이 전당대회를 겨냥한 행보를 넓혀가고 있다.)

On the 15th, Prime Minister Kim presided over the "Pan-Government Council for the Great Transformation of National Space" at the Prime Minister's official residence in Seoul, followed by a luncheon meeting with nine Democratic Party regional government heads-elect. The meeting was reportedly arranged to explain the content of the government's "Great Transformation of National Space Project." <<> Attendees at the luncheon included nine Democratic Party-affiliated metropolitan and provincial governor-elects: Incheon (Park Chan-dae), South Jeolla/Gwangju (Min Hyung-bae), Daejeon (Heo Tae-jeong), Ulsan (Kim Sang-wook), Gyeonggi (Choo Mi-ae), Sejong (Jo Sang-ho), North Chungcheong (Shin Yong-han), North Jeolla (Lee Won-taek), and Jeju (Wi Seong-gon). Seven regional elected officials from the People Power Party, including Seoul (Oh Se-hoon) and Daegu (Choo Kyung-ho), were invited but did not attend. It is unusual for the Prime Minister to hold a separate meeting with regional government heads-elect immediately after local elections. The previous day, Prime Minister Kim also attended a workshop for local election winners hosted by the North Chungcheong Provincial Party in Cheongju, North Chungcheong, where he stated, "It is time for (the Democratic Party) to enter a period of tension and innovation." <<> Prime Minister Kim and lawmaker Song Young-gil are also reportedly scheduled to attend a workshop for Democratic Party-affiliated South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City councilors-elect to be held in Boseong, South Jeolla, on the 16th. Song plans to visit Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang, and Pyeongsan Village in Yangsan on the 18th, where he will meet with former First Lady Kwon Yang-sook and former President Moon Jae-in. <<> Lawmaker Kim Yong-min, the Democratic Party secretary of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, also said on MBC Radio the same day that it was "true that he is considering" running for party leader. <<> Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (김 총리는 15일 서울 국무총리 공관에서 ‘국토공간 대전환 범정부 추진협의회’를 주재한 뒤 민주당 광역단체장 당선자 9명과 오찬 간담회를 했다. 정부가 추진하는 ‘국토공간 대전환 프로젝트’의 내용을 설명하기 위해 마련한 자리라고 한다.)

item.title: "Jang Dong-hyuk's Arbitrary Decision" – Internal Backlash Over People Power Party Leadership's Vote on Re-election Appeal (“장동혁의 독단”…국힘 지도부 ‘재선거 소청’ 의결에 내부 반발)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) leadership, under Jang Dong-hyuk, has unilaterally decided to file an "election appeal" with the National Election Commission (NEC) demanding re-elections in six regions—Seoul (where Mayor Oh Se-hoon was elected), Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, and Gwangju/Jeonnam—over the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections. The decision, made without gathering input, has sparked internal backlash, with critics calling it an "arbitrary decision." (국민의힘 ‘장동혁 지도부’가 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 오세훈 서울시장이 당선된 서울 지역과 경기, 인천, 부산, 울산, 광주·전남 등 6개 지역에 대해 재선거를 요구하기 위한 ‘선거소청’을 선거관리위원회에 제기하기로 일방적으로 결정했다. 당 지도부가 의견 수렴 없이 이러한 결정을 하자 당내에서 “독단적 결정”이라는 반발이 터져 나온다.)

On the 15th, the PPP held an emergency Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly and announced a unanimous decision to file election appeals for all elections in areas affected by polling stations where ballot shortages infringed on voters' suffrage rights. Of the eight leadership members, six attended the meeting (Jang Dong-hyuk, Jeong Jeom-sik, Shin Dong-uk, Kim Min-su, Yang Hyang-ja, and Jo Gwang-han), while Supreme Council members Kim Jae-won and Woo Jae-joon were absent. (국민의힘은 15일 오후 국회에서 긴급 최고위원회 회의를 열고 투표용지 부족 사태로 인해 유권자의 참정권이 침해된 투표소와 관련된 지역의 모든 선거에 대해 선거소청을 하기로 만장일치로 결정했다고 밝혔다. 이날 회의에는 당 지도부 8명 가운데 6명(장동혁·정점식·신동욱·김민수·양향자·조광한)이 참석했고, 김재원·우재준 최고위원은 불참했다.)

Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the meeting, "We decided to pursue a full re-election," adding, "This covers all candidates affected by the ballot issue in the June 3 local elections, including heads of metropolitan and local governments, metropolitan and local councilors, and proportional representation councilors." The election appeal targets polling stations in six regions where ballot shortages occurred, such as Songpa District. The PPP did not disclose specific details about the polling stations subject to the appeal. By-elections for the National Assembly and education superintendent elections were excluded from the appeal. (최보윤 당 수석대변인은 최고위 직후 기자들과 만나 “전면 재선거를 하기로 결정했다”며 “광역·기초단체장, 광역·기초의원, 광역·기초비례의원 등 6·3 지방선거에서 (투표용지가) 문제 되는 후보군이 전면 포함되는 범위”라고 말했다. 선거소청 제기는 6개 지역 중 투표용지 부족사태가 발생한 송파구 등 일부 투표소가 대상이다. 이날 국민의힘은 선거소청 대상 투표소 현황에 대해선 구체적으로 밝히지 않았다. 국회의원 재보궐선거와 교육감 선거는 소청 대상에서 제외했다.)

Regarding the decision without a general meeting of lawmakers, Choi said, "The right to file an appeal lies with the party leader," and "We had to decide urgently because the filing deadline is this Wednesday (the 17th), and we couldn't delay it any further." An election appeal is a procedure to challenge the validity of an election or results with the NEC, and it must be filed within 14 days of election day, making the 17th the deadline. (최 수석대변인은 의원총회를 거치지 않고 이러한 결정을 한 것에 대해 “소청권자가 당대표”라며 “소청 기한이 이번주 수요일(17일)까지라 급하게 결정해야 해 더 늦출 수 없었다”고 말했다. 선거소청은 선거·당선 효력에 대해 선관위에 불복을 제기하는 절차로, 선거일 후 14일 이내에 제기해야 하기 때문에 오는 17일이 마지노선이다.)

The unilateral decision by the party leadership has triggered internal dissent. A two-term lawmaker from the Yeongnam region stated, "We had agreed to discuss Jang's re-election claim at this week's general meeting. Pushing through the agenda suddenly disregards lawmakers," and "Demanding a full re-election instead of a rational response is irresponsible." A lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area criticized, "The party leader handling it arbitrarily is beyond common sense." Lawmaker Kim Yong-tae appeared on YTN Radio and criticized the move as "an attempt to tarnish Mayor Oh Se-hoon," adding, "The leader of the main opposition party should be held accountable for such irresponsible actions." (당 지도부의 일방적인 결정을 두고 당내에선 반발이 터져 나왔다. 영남권 재선 의원은 “장 대표의 재선거 주장에 대해 이번주 의총에서 논의하기로 했다. 그런데 해당 안건을 갑자기 통과시킨 건 의원들을 무시한 것이다”며 “합리적 대응이 아닌 전면 재선거 요구도 무책임하다”라고 했다. 수도권 한 의원도 “당 대표가 독단으로 처리하는 것은 상식 밖”이라고 비판했다. 김용태 의원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오에 출연해 “오세훈 시장을 흠집내기 위한 것”이라며 “제1야당의 당 대표가 책임있지 못한 행동을 하는 것에 대해서는 분명한 평가가 따라야 한다”고 비판했다.)

Aides to Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon commented, "This is not about a full re-election for Seoul but a procedure to file an appeal for problematic polling stations within Seoul, so we understand Seoul was mentioned," and added, "We will monitor the situation." (오세훈 서울시장 쪽은 “서울시의 경우 전면 재선거 차원이 아니라 서울시 가운데 문제 되는 투표소의 소청을 하는 절차라 서울시가 언급됐다고 알고 있다”며 “지켜보겠다”고 했다.)

Kang Jun-hyeon, chief spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized in a written briefing, "The PPP's re-election appeal is an act of election denial and an outdated ploy to exploit claims of election fraud for partisan gain." (강준현 더불어민주당 수석대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 “국민의힘의 재선거 소청은 선거 불복이자, 당리당략을 위해 부정선거에 편승한 구태”라고 비판했다.)

The NEC must render a decision within 60 days of receiving the election appeal. If the NEC accepts the appeal, a re-election must be held within 30 days of the decision notification. The Public Official Election Act stipulates that election invalidations are only granted when "it is determined that the outcome of the election was affected." (선관위는 선거소청을 접수한 날로부터 60일 안에 결정을 내려야 한다. 선관위가 소청을 받아들이면 결정 통지일로부터 30일 이내에 재선거가 실시된다. 공직선거법은 ‘선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때’에만 선거 무효를 결정하도록 하고 있다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee meets Pope Leo XIV in private audience, likely proposed a visit to North Korea (이 대통령, 레오 14세 교황 단독 면담…방북 제안한 듯)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently on an official visit to the Vatican, reportedly proposed on the 15th (local time) that Pope Leo XIV visit North Korea for peace on the Korean Peninsula. (바티칸을 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 15일(현지시각) 한반도 평화를 위해 레오 14세 교황에게 방북을 제안한 것으로 알려졌다.)

President Lee held a 30-minute private audience with Pope Leo XIV at the Apostolic Palace in the Vatican on this day. National Security Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing after the meeting, “President Lee conveyed to the Pope the wishes of our people and the government’s plans regarding peace policies on the Korean Peninsula, and reaffirmed the Vatican’s unwavering support and interest in the goals of peace and reconciliation on the Korean Peninsula.” (이 대통령은 이날 바티칸 교황청 사도궁에서 레오 14세 교황과 30분여간 단독 면담했다. 위성락 국가안보실장은 면담 뒤 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 한반도 평화 정책에 대한 우리 국민의 염원과 정부의 구상을 교황에게 말했고, 교황청의 한반도 평화와 화해 목표를 위한 변함없는 지지와 관심을 재확인했다”고 말했다.)

Director Wi added, “President Lee and the Pope agreed to work closely together for the successful hosting of the World Youth Day (WYD),” and “on the occasion of this event, he respectfully invited the Pope to visit South Korea.” The World Youth Day is the world’s largest Catholic youth event, set to take place in Seoul in 2027. A senior official at the presidential office stated, “Messages of reconciliation and peace on the Korean Peninsula sent by the Vatican or the Pope are important,” adding, “Especially, if the Pope visits Korea and delivers such a message at the World Youth Day, wouldn’t it be more helpful?” (위 실장은 이어 “이 대통령과 교황은 세계청년대회(WYD)의 성공적 개최를 위해 긴밀히 협력해 나가기로 했다”며 “이 대회를 계기로 교황에게 정중히 방한 초청을 했다”고 말했다. 세계청년대회는 세계 최대 규모의 가톨릭 청년 행사로 2027년 서울에서 열린다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “교황청이나 교황이 발신하는 한반도 화해와 평화에 대한 메시지가 중요하다”며 “특히 교황이 방한해 세계청년대회에서 그런 메시지를 발신한다면 더 도움이 되지 않겠느냐”고 말했다.)

It is known that President Lee requested during the meeting that the Pope visit North Korea at a suitable opportunity. It appears that the proposal was for the Pope to visit South Korea next year for the World Youth Day and then travel to North Korea around that time. Regarding this, a senior official at the presidential office said, “The Pope is not the type to engage in give-and-take conversation; he mainly listens, so I’m not sure what his reaction was,” adding, “For a visit to North Korea, an invitation from the North is needed, and the procedure is complicated.” The day before, President Lee mentioned the June 15 Joint Declaration in a commemorative speech at a ‘Special Mass for Peace and Solidarity’ held at the Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls in Rome, stating, “I firmly believe that the spark of that hope is still alive.” (이 대통령은 면담 중 교황에게 적당한 계기에 방북해 달라고 요청한 것으로 알려졌다. 교황이 내년 세계청년대회 참석을 위해 방한한 뒤 이때를 전후해 방북해 달라고 제안한 것으로 보인다. 이에 대해 청와대 고위 관계자는 “교황은 주고받기식의 대화를 하시는 스타일이 아니고 주로 경청하신다고 하는데 어떤 반응을 보였는지는 잘 모르겠다”며 “(방북하려면) 북한의 초청이 있어야 하고 절차가 복잡하다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 전날 로마 ‘성 밖 성 바오로 대성당’에서 열린 ‘평화와 연대를 위한 특별 미사’ 기념 연설에서 6·15 남북공동선언을 언급하며 “저는 지금도 그 희망의 불씨가 살아 있다고 굳게 믿는다”고 말했다.)

Last July, President Lee met with Cardinal You Heung-sik, Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy, and referenced this event, saying, “I thought it might be good if the Pope, on his way to promote peace on the Korean Peninsula, could also stop by North Korea.” The day before, Cardinal You told reporters at the Vatican, “North Korea must invite him and create the conditions. Since the Pope is American, he could play a role in North Korea-U.S. relations more than before.” (이 대통령은 지난해 7월 교황청 성직자부 장관인 유흥식 추기경을 만나 이 대회를 거론하며 “(교황이) 한반도 평화를 위해 오시는 길에 북한도 한번 들러보시면 어떨까 하는 생각이 들었다”고 말했다. 유 추기경은 전날 바티칸에서 기자들에게 “북한에서 (교황을) 초청하고, 여건을 만들어야 한다. 교황님이 미국 출신이니 예전보다 북-미 관계에서도 역할을 할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

After the meeting with the Pope, President Lee also met with Secretary of State Pietro Parolin, where the possibility of a papal visit to North Korea was raised. A senior official at the presidential office said, “It was brought up in the context of resuming dialogue in inter-Korean relations and reconciliation on the Korean Peninsula,” but added, “However, this is a complex issue. Going to North Korea is not something easily arranged from outside.” (이 대통령은 교황 면담 뒤 피에트로 파롤린 국무원장과도 면담했는데 이 자리에서도 교황의 방북 가능성이 거론됐다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “남북관계 대화 재개, 한반도에서의 화해 차원에서 (교황 방북이) 제기가 됐다”며 “그러나 이 문제는 좀 복잡한 문제다. 북한에 가는 문제를 밖에서 간다고 하기가 쉬운 문제가 아니다”라고 말했다.)

The senior official reported that President Lee said during the meeting, “Inter-Korean relations are currently severed and difficult, but we will pursue tension reduction and trust-building through various means. It will take time and patience, but we will continue to make efforts. If we knock, it will open.” In response, Secretary of State Parolin replied, “Not just patience, but hope is needed.” (이 대통령은 면담에서 “남북관계가 지금은 단절돼서 어렵지만, 다양한 방법으로 긴장 완화와 신뢰 구축을 추진할 것이다. 시간과 인내가 필요하겠지만, 계속 노력할 것이다. 두드리면 열릴 것”이라고 말했다고 이 고위 관계자는 전했다. 이에 파롤린 국무원장은 “인내뿐만 아니라 희망이 필요하다”고 답했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee gifted the Pope a sculpture titled ‘In God’s Arms’ and a white porcelain multi-purpose container. (한편 이 대통령은 교황에게 ‘하느님의 품’ 조각상과 백자 다용도 합을 선물했다.)

Vatican City/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (바티칸/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee "Expects Resumption of Safe Navigation in Strait of Hormuz... Welcomes End-of-War Negotiations" (이 대통령 “호르무즈 해협 안전 항행 재개 기대…종전 협상 환영”)
item.description:
President Lee, who is on a tour of Europe, said on the 15th (local time) regarding the conclusion of end-of-war negotiations between the United States and Iran: "I welcome it. This is a significant step forward in resolving a situation that the international community has long hoped for." (유럽을 순방 중인 대통령이 15일(현지시각) 미국과 이란 간 종전 협상이 타결된 것과 관련해 “환영한다. 이는 국제사회가 오랫동안 기대해 온 사태 해결을 위한 중요한 진전”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee posted on X (formerly Twitter) on the same day: "I highly commend President Donald Trump's leadership that led to the conclusion of these negotiations, as well as the diplomatic efforts of the negotiating parties and related countries. I hope that through this agreement, peace and stability in the Middle East region will be quickly restored, and a foundation will be laid for the safety and prosperity of the region's residents." ( 이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “이번 협상 타결을 이끌어낸 도널드 트럼프 대통령의 리더십과 협상 당사국 및 관련국들의 외교적 노력을 높이 평가한다”며 “이번 합의를 통해 중동 지역의 평화와 안정이 조속히 회복되고, 역내 주민들의 안전과 번영을 위한 기반이 마련되길 기대한다”고 말했다. )

President Lee also stated: "I also hope that global energy supply and demand will stabilize, and that all vessels, including our ships and crew members who have faced restrictions in navigating the Strait of Hormuz, will be able to resume safe operations as soon as possible. The heightened tension in the Middle East region has led to rising energy prices and logistics costs, placing a significant burden on domestic prices, corporate management, and daily life in general. While it may be difficult to feel changes in the short term, I expect that the uncertainty in our economy will gradually be resolved, providing an opportunity for recovery." ( 이 대통령은 “아울러 글로벌 에너지 수급이 안정화되고, 그간 호르무즈 해협 항행에 제약을 받아온 우리 선박과 선원들을 포함한 모든 선박이 조속히 안전한 운항을 재개할 수 있길 바란다”며 “그동안 중동 지역의 긴장 고조는 에너지 가격과 물류비 상승을 초래하며 국내 물가와 기업 경영, 일상생활 전반에 상당한 부담으로 작용해 왔다. 단기간 내 변화를 체감하긴 어렵겠지만, 우리 경제의 불확실성이 점차 해소되며 회복의 계기가 마련되길 기대한다”고 말했다. )

President Lee added: "As a responsible member of the international community, South Korea will not spare the necessary support and cooperation to ensure that this agreement contributes to world peace and prosperity beyond the Middle East region. President Trump announced on the same day (local time) during a bilateral meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron at the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, that both sides had signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to end the war with Iran. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi also stated that a signing ceremony for the MOU with the U.S. is highly likely to take place in Switzerland on the 19th. ( 트럼프 대통령은 이날(현지시각) 프랑스 휴양지 에비앙레뱅에서 개막한 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에서 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령과 양자 회담하며 이란과의 종전 양해각서(MOU)에 양측이 모두 서명했다고 밝혔다. 아바스 아라그치 이란 외무장관도 미국과의 종전 양해각서(MOU) 서명식이 오는 19일 스위스에서 열릴 가능성이 높다고 이날 밝혔다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Calls President Lee "World-Class"... Seeking a Way Out of Dilemma? (정청래 “이 대통령은 ‘월클’”…진퇴양난 돌파구 찾나)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who is under pressure to resign as party head and not run in the August national convention, is continuing efforts to solidify his support base that favors a strong ideological stance while minimizing confrontation with President Lee Jae-myung. He appears to be weighing whether to run, wary of the convention turning into a "Lee vs. Jung" showdown. (대표직 사퇴와 8월 전당대회 불출마 압박을 받는 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 이재명 대통령과의 대립각은 최소화하면서, 선명성을 선호하는 자신의 지지층을 다지는 행보를 이어가고 있다. 전당대회가 ‘명-청 대결’ 구도로 짜이는 것을 경계하며, 출마 여부를 저울질하는 것으로 보인다.)

During a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly on the 15th, Jung praised President Lee’s achievements from his Italy trip, calling him a "world-class leader." He also said in a speech at the ceremony marking the 26th anniversary of the June 15 inter-Korean summit, held in the afternoon, "We have President Lee by our side, who has taken the baton from President Kim Dae-jung. I am confident he is the peacemaker who best embodies the spirit of the late President Kim." <<> Jung's remarks are not unrelated to the strong backlash from the presidential office last month over his comment on the 10th that "the people are eternal, but governments are short-lived," which was met with reactions questioning, "Is he trying to split the party?" For Jung, directly confronting President Lee Jae-myung, who has just passed the first year of his term, is a significant burden, as many party members who support the Lee Jae-myung administration could turn their backs on him. A second-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "Jung likely wants to escape the situation where he has ended up in a direct confrontation with President Lee, rather than a competition with rivals for party leadership." Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, close to Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, targeted Jung on the same day, saying, "The ruling party is a community of destiny that shares its fate with the president. The party, government, and presidential office must become one." <<> During the Supreme Council meeting, Jung again raised the message of "clearing up the insurrection," saying, "A constitutional amendment is needed to prevent an illegal emergency martial law." Following his push to "completely abolish supplementary investigation powers," he once again emphasized a clear ideological stance for the party members who support him. <<> Around the party, there are many observations that Jung is contemplating whether to run in the convention amid a dilemma. Another second-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "Jung likely thinks that giving up on running could make it difficult to seek a political future later. Being effectively pushed out without receiving an evaluation from party members is a difficult option for him to accept." A first-term lawmaker added, "If he fails in his bid for re-election as party leader, the risk of being excluded from nominations for the 2028 general election cannot be ignored." <<> Some argue that, with President Lee Jae-myung effectively signaling a veto on Jung's re-election, even if Jung is elected as leader again at the convention, it could place a considerable burden on him personally and on the ruling party as a whole. A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "Just as Jung previously created an opportunity for a comeback by leading the 'The Cut Campaign Team' (a support group for candidates who failed to get nominated ahead of the 2016 general election), this time too, he may decide to step back for the good of the government and the ruling party," adding, "Given the intensified conflict within the ruling party, even if Jung succeeds in being re-elected as leader, he is bound to face a very difficult path." <<> Amid this, there are voices within the Democratic Party that attention should be paid to the declining approval ratings for the government and ruling party in the Honam region, which has the largest number of party members. <<> A second-term lawmaker said, "Jung is making many statements that seem intended to rally the hardline support base, but the regular party members (of whom over 30 percent are concentrated in Honam) will seriously consider the party-presidential office relationship. The direction of the national convention depends on the sentiments of the Honam electorate," he said. <<> Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 정 대표는 15일 국회 최고위원회의에서 이 대통령의 이탈리아 순방 성과를 언급하며 “이 대통령은 월드 클래스 지도자”라고 추어올렸다. 그는 오후에 열린 6·15 남북정상회담 26주년 기념식 축사에서도 “우리 곁에는 김대중 대통령의 바통을 이어받은 이 대통령이 있다. 김 전 대통령의 정신을 가장 잘 체현하고 있는 피스메이커라 확신한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Jun-hyung Elected New Floor Leader of Innovation Party: “Refuses Coalition in Context of Political Struggle” (혁신당 새 원내대표에 김준형…“정치투쟁 맥락의 합당은 거부”)
item.description:
Kim Jun-hyung, a member of the National Assembly, has been elected as the new floor leader of the Innovation Party for the Fatherland. (조국혁신당 새 원내대표에 김준형 의원이 선출됐다.)

A lawmaker, Kim was elected floor leader on the 16th at a general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly, running unopposed in the third-term floor leader election and receiving unanimous votes from the 12 lawmakers present. (김 원내대표는 16일 국회에서 열린 의원총회에서 3기 원내대표 선거에 단독으로 입후보해 의원 12명의 만장일치로 당선됐다.)

Kim stated, “Can we confidently say that the prosecution reform and the eradication of the insurrection are progressing in proportion to the effort we have poured in? It can never be completed without solidarity and cooperation for democracy, progress, and reform.” He added, “For the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and for reform and progress, I am willing to help in any way.” He continued, “In the context of political struggle, I refuse any coalition or similar alliances. I refuse to be treated carelessly.” (김 원내대표는 “우리가 쏟은 노력만큼 검찰개혁과 내란청산이 이뤄지고 있다고 자신있게 말할 수 있나. 민주진보개혁의 연대와 협력 없이는 결코 완성될 수 없다”며 “이재명 정부의 성공을 위해서라면 개혁과 진보를 위해서라면 얼마든지 돕겠다”고 말했다. 그는 이어 “정치투쟁의 맥락이라면 합당 등 어떤 연대도 거부한다. 함부로 취급 당하기를 거부한다”고 말했다.)

Kim, a former international politics scholar, served as the head of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy under the Moon Jae-in administration. He entered the National Assembly as a proportional representative of the Innovation Party in the 22nd general election and served as the chair of the Policy Committee in the previous floor leadership. (그는 국제정치학자 출신으로 문재인 정부에서 국립외교원장을 역임했다. 지난 22대 총선에서 혁신당 비례대표로 국회에 입성했으며 전임 원내지도부에서는 정책위의장을 맡았다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Extends 'Warm Congratulations' and Flower Basket to Xi Jinping on His Birthday, Flaunting North Korea-China Closeness (김정은, 생일 맞은 시진핑에 “열렬히 축하” 꽃바구니…북-중 밀착 과시)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un sent a congratulatory message and a flower basket to Chinese President Xi Jinping on his birthday (June 15), North Korea's Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 16th. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 생일(6월15일)을 맞아 축하의 글과 꽃바구니를 보냈다고 조선중앙통신이 16일 보도했다.)

KCNA reported on the previous day (15th) that “Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message and a congratulatory flower basket to Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and President of the People's Republic of China.” The flower basket bore the inscription: “Warm congratulations on the birthday of Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping.” The news agency added that Chairman Kim “sincerely wished Comrade General Secretary good health and greater achievements in leading the cause of socialist construction in China as the core leader of the Communist Party of China.” The congratulatory message and flower basket were delivered by North Korea's special envoy to China to the International Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. (조선중앙통신은 전날(15일) “김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 북한 국무위원장이 시진핑 공산당 중앙위원회 총서기 겸 국가주석에게 축하 말씀과 축하 꽃바구니를 보냈다”고 전했다. 꽃바구니에는 “시진핑 총서기 동지의 탄생일을 열렬히 축하합니다”라고 쓰여 있었다. 통신은 김 위원장이 “총서기 동지가 건강하여 중국공산당의 영도 핵심으로서 중국의 사회주의 건설 위업을 영도하는 데서 보다 큰 성과를 거두기를 진심으로 축원했다”고 보도했다. 이러한 축하 메시지와 꽃바구니는 중국 주재 북한 특명전권대사가 중국 공산당 중앙위원회 대외연락부 쪽으로 전달했다.)

Chairman Kim's delivery of the congratulatory message marks the first public communication between the two leaders since President Xi visited North Korea for the first time in seven years on June 8-9. This is the first time Kim has publicly congratulated Xi on his birthday since Xi's 70th birthday in 2023. It appears to underscore the strengthened bilateral relations following the summit held in Pyongyang on the 8th, where they emphasized elevating the strategic relationship between North Korea and China. (김 위원장의 축하 메시지 전달은 지난 8∼9일 시 주석이 7년 만에 방북한 이후 두 정상의 첫 공개 소통 행보다. 김 위원장이 시 주석의 생일을 축하했다고 공개한 건 지난 2023년 시 주석의 칠순 생일 이후 처음이다. 지난 8일 평양에서 연 정상회담에서 북-중의 전략적 관계 격상을 강조한 뒤 가까워진 양자관계를 강조한 것으로 보인다.)

By Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democrats ask People Power Party "Why only six locations?" over petition for re-election… "Seems based on whether 'Yoon Again' would win" (민주, 국힘 재선거 소청에 “왜 6곳만?…‘윤 어게인’ 당선 여부가 기준”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has uniformly criticized the People Power Party for its decision to file election petition requests for re-election in six regions that experienced ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections, calling on them to "immediately withdraw the indiscriminate election petition and conspiracy theory incitement." <<> Floor leader Han Byung-do said in a floor strategy meeting today: "They label it a 'full re-election' but then speak as if it's not nationwide. What's even more absurd is that they are arguing for nullifying the election regardless of the will of the elected Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon." <<> Floor leader Han added: "Ballot shortages occurred only in some polling stations—are they trying to invalidate the votes of all citizens? Immediately withdraw the indiscriminate election petition and conspiracy theory incitement, and instead of fiddling with the petition document, prepare more thoroughly for the parliamentary investigation." <<> Chief Deputy Floor Leader Cheon Jun-ho also said: "They say they are filing petitions only for six areas where ballot shortages occurred. I'm truly curious. Why did they not file petitions for Daegu and South Gyeongsang, which also experienced ballot shortages? Is the criterion for filing petitions whether it concerns a 'Yoon Again' victory?" <<> He continued: "This petition, which no one can understand, is itself an attempt to rig the election—a move to rationalize former President Yoon Suk-yeol's insurrection or merely to protect their own positions. Whatever the purpose, the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership is nothing more and nothing less than a 'Yoon Again' leadership." <<> The previous day, the People Power Party's leadership under Jang Dong-hyuk decided to file election petitions with the National Election Commission to demand re-elections in six regions regarding the June 3 local election ballot shortage incident: Seoul (where Mayor Oh Se-hoon was elected), Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, and Gwangju/Jeollanam-do. <<> An election petition is a procedure to challenge the validity of an election or a candidate's election to the National Election Commission. The commission must make a decision within 60 days of receiving the petition. If the commission accepts the petition, a re-election is held within 30 days of the decision notification date. The Public Official Election Act stipulates that an election can only be invalidated when it is determined that the outcome was influenced. <<> Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거에서 투표용지 부족사태가 있었던 6개 지역 재선거를 위한 선거소청을 하기로 한 국민의힘을 향해 “묻지마 선거소청과 음모론 선동을 즉각 철회하라”고 일제히 비판했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Include North Chungcheong in Election Contest... Aiming for Nationwide By-elections" (장동혁 “선거소청에 충북도 포함…전국 재선거가 목표”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) Leader Jang Dong-hyuk announced on the 16th that he would include North Chungcheong Province among the regions targeted for contesting the June 3 local elections. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거 소청 대상 지역에 충북을 포함시키겠다고 16일 밝혔다.)

Appearing on the Munhwa Ilbo YouTube show "Heo Min's News Show" that day, Jang stated, "North Chungcheong also had issues with the disappearance of the voter list," adding, "We will identify all problematic areas by tomorrow and expand the scope of what we can contest to the maximum nationwide." (장 대표는 이날 문화일보 유튜브 ‘허민의 뉴스쇼’에 출연해 “충북에서도 선거인명부가 없어지는 문제가 있었다”며 “내일까지 추가로 문제 지역을 다 찾아서 소청할 수 있는 부분을 전국 최대로 확대하겠다”고 말했다.)

This follows the previous day's decision at an emergency Supreme Council meeting to unilaterally file election contests demanding re-elections in six regions: Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, and Gwangju·South Jeolla. An election contest is a procedure to challenge the validity of an election or the winner's election before the National Election Commission, and must be filed within 14 days of election day, making the 17th the deadline. (이는 전날 긴급 최고위원회를 열어 서울과 경기, 인천, 부산, 울산, 광주·전남 등 6개 지역에 대해 재선거를 요구하기 위한 선거 소청을 제기하기로 일방적으로 결정한 데 이은 것이다. 선거소청은 선거·당선 효력에 대해 선관위에 불복을 제기하는 절차로, 선거일 후 14일 이내에 제기해야 하기 때문에 오는 17일이 마지노선이다.)

Jang said, "The contest is just the beginning. (Issues like ballot shortages) are hard to view as simple mistakes; if such problems have accumulated, it indicates intentional mismanagement," adding, "We will fight over the aspects that can be contested in the election contest, with the aim of nationwide by-elections." He further added, "Those who say (the party leadership) is trying to tarnish Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon are trying to tarnish the party itself." (장 대표는 “소청은 시작에 불과하다. (투표용지 부족 등은) 단순 실수로 보기 어렵고, 누적됐다면 의도적인 관리 부실 문제”라며 “소청에서 다툴 수 있는 부분을 다투되 전국 재선거를 목표로 싸워나가겠다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “(당 지도부가) 오세훈 서울시장을 흠집내려고 한다는 말을 하는 사람은 당을 흠집내려 하는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

The non-mainstream faction within the PPP, which opposed the Supreme Council's decision the day before, submitted a request to floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik on the same day to convene a general meeting of lawmakers on the 17th. (전날 최고위 결정에 반발하고 있는 비당권파는 이날 정점식 원내대표에게 17일 의원총회를 소집해 달라는 요구서를 제출했다.)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon posted on Facebook, saying, "I am very concerned that the golden time for the PPP to restore public trust is being wasted due to a specific individual's political calculations," and "I hope the general meeting of lawmakers serves as an opportunity to show the right direction for the party to move forward." (오세훈 서울시장은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “국민의힘이 국민 신뢰를 회복할 수 있는 골든타임이 특정인의 정치적 계산 때문에 허비되는 현실이 매우 우려스럽다”며 “의원총회가 당이 나아갈 올바른 방향을 보여주는 계기가 되길 바란다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Jang Dong-hyuk Only Makes Divisive Re-election Calls… Must Listen to the Public's Voice" (오세훈 “장동혁 소모적 재선거 주장만…국민 목소리에 귀 기울여야”)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon directly took aim at People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 16th, who is pushing for election petitions to demand re-elections in six regions, including Seoul, where ballot shortages occurred: "Stop using slogans for political survival and listen to the stern voice of the people." (오세훈 서울시장이 16일 서울을 포함해 투표 용지가 부족했던 6개 지역의 재선거를 요구하기 위한 선거소청을 추진하는 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 향해 “자리보전용 구호를 멈추고 국민의 준엄한 목소리에 귀 기울여야 한다”고 직격했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Oh stated, "This ballot shortage incident is an unprecedented serious violation of voting rights in the history of democracy," adding, "What the party should do now is a thorough investigation of the facts, punishment of those responsible, and fundamental reform of the election system." Oh emphasized, "Nevertheless, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is driving the entire party toward divisive re-election demands. The people already clearly know: Is this a struggle for truth-finding, or is it a strategic slogan to protect his own shaky political position?" This criticism suggested Jang is exploiting the situation to retain his party leadership role. (오 시장은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이번 투표용지 부족 사태는 민주주의 역사에 유례없는 중대한 참정권 침해 사건”이라며 “지금 당이 해야 할 일은 철저한 진상 규명과 책임자 처벌 그리고 선거제도의 근본적 개혁”이라고 했다. 오 시장은 “그런데도 장동혁 대표는 온 당을 소모적인 재선거 주장으로만 몰아가고 있다”며 “국민은 이미 똑똑히 알고 계신다. 그것이 진실 규명을 위한 투쟁인지 아니면 자신의 흔들리는 정치적 입지를 지키기 위한 정략적 구호인지”라고 강조했다. 장 대표가 자신의 당대표 자리를 유지하기 위해 이번 사태를 활용하고 있다고 비판한 것이다.)

Oh continued, "The recent rise in party approval ratings is the public's last hope for a changing and reforming PPP. But is the current party leadership truly living up to that expectation?" He added, "The pure aspirations of the youth in their 20s and 30s who have taken to the streets to uphold democracy must not be consumed as fuel for a particular politician's political survival. These young people did not take to the square to become someone's political shield." The mayor stressed, "What PPP should now focus on is conducting a parliamentary investigation and special counsel probe to uncover the truth, punish those responsible, and present to the public comprehensive reform measures, including a level of restructuring equivalent to dismantling the National Election Commission." He concluded, "It is deeply concerning that the golden hour for restoring public trust is being wasted due to one individual's political calculations. I hope the upcoming parliamentary caucus will serve as an opportunity to show the right direction for PPP." PPP lawmakers are expected to hold a caucus around the 18th to discuss issues including Jang's leadership status. (오 시장은 “최근의 정당 지지율 상승 역시 변화하고 쇄신하는 국민의힘에 거는 국민들의 마지막 기대감”이라며 “그러나 지금 당 지도부는 과연 그 기대에 부응하고 있나”라고 했다. 오 시장은 “민주주의를 바로 세우겠다며 거리로 나온 2030 청년들의 순수한 열망이 특정 정치인의 정치적 생존을 위한 연료로 소비돼선 안 된다. 청년들은 누군가의 정치적 방패가 되기 위해 광장에 나온 것이 아니다”라며 “지금 국민의힘이 집중해야 할 책무는 국정조사와 특검을 통해 진상을 끝까지 밝혀 책임자를 처벌하고, 선관위에 대해 해체 수준의 혁신 개혁 방안을 마련해 국민 앞에 제시하는 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “국민의 신뢰를 회복할 수 있는 골든타임이 특정인의 정치적 계산 때문에 허비되는 현실이 매우 우려스럽다”며 “다가오는 원내 의원총회가 국민의힘이 나아갈 올바른 방향을 보여주는 계기가 되기를 바란다”고 덧붙였다. 국민의힘 의원들은 18일께 의원총회를 열어 장 대표 거취 문제 등을 논의할 예정이다.)

That morning, Jang appeared on Munhwa Ilbo's YouTube program "Heo Min's News Show" and announced the inclusion of North Chungcheong Province in the list of regions for election appeals, repeatedly calling for a nationwide re-election. (장 대표는 이날 오전 문화일보 유튜브 ‘허민의 뉴스쇼’에 출연해 소청 대상 지역에 충북을 추가로 포함하겠다고 밝히며 전국 재선거를 거듭 주장했다.)

By Jang Na-rae, wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Min-seok on Vote-Counting Hall Siege: “Illegal Acts, Immediate Action at the Scene” (김민석 총리, 개표소 봉쇄 시위에 “불법 행위, 현장서 즉시 조치”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 16th regarding the “vote-counting hall siege protest” in Jamsil, “The government will respond decisively to illegal acts as a warning for all.” (김민석 국무총리는 16일 잠실 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’와 관련해 “정부는 불법 행위에 대해서는 일벌백계 차원에서 단호하게 대응할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

During a cabinet meeting combined with an emergency economic meeting held that morning at the Government Complex Seoul, Prime Minister Kim said, “The government humbly listens to and respects the legitimate concerns of citizens regarding violations of suffrage rights,” but added, “Using this situation as a pretext for some participants to infringe on the rights of others can never be justified.” He further noted, “The handball stadium at Jamsil Olympic Park, used as a vote-counting hall, has been under siege for over ten days. Privately controlling access for those authorized to enter is a serious illegal act that is absolutely unacceptable under any circumstances.” <<> “Otherwise, why would the head of the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee have requested the deployment of public authority? If they block fencers from retrieving their fencing swords, what can we possibly do?” he asked in response. In addition, Prime Minister Kim urged, “Moreover, isn’t the vote counting at the scene already complete? I ask the police to take immediate action on-site against illegal actors in accordance with the law and principles, and to thoroughly investigate any suspected illegal activities through evidence collection and hold them strictly accountable.” <<> The Jamsil vote-counting hall siege protest, triggered by the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections, has entered its 12th day. The Korean Sport & Olympic Committee held a press conference the previous day requesting the deployment of public authority to the Olympic Park handball stadium, the vote-counting site. It has been reported that the blockade by protesters has prevented the national fencing team, preparing for the upcoming Asian Fencing Championships, and the Korea Underwater Finswimming Association, preparing to host the Incheon World Finswimming Championships, from retrieving training equipment, causing difficulties. Currently, police and officials from the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee are attempting to enter the handball stadium but are blocked by protesters, resulting in a standoff. <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 열린 국무회의 겸 비상경제본부회의에서 “정부는 참정권 침해에 대한 국민들의 정당한 문제 제기에 대해서는 겸허하게 말씀을 듣고 또 존중하고 있다”면서도 “이런 상황을 빌미로 일부 참석자들이 타인의 권리를 침해하는 것은 결코 정당화될 수가 없다”라고 말했다. 또 “(개표소로 사용된) 잠실 올림픽공원 핸드볼 경기장이 열흘 넘게 봉쇄되고 있다”며 “(시위대가) 출입 권한을 가진 분들을 사적으로 통제하는 것은 어떤 경우라도 절대 용납될 수 없는 심각한 불법 행위”라고 했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon opposes People Power Party's election appeal, saying "Leadership, aware of its weak position, is using it politically" (오세훈, 국힘 선거소청 반발 “지도부가 빈약한 입지 의식해 정략적 이용”)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon criticized the decision by the People Power Party (PPP) leadership to file for re-election appeals in six regions, including Seoul, over the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections, calling it "a highly political maneuver." (오세훈 서울시장이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 국민의힘 지도부가 서울 등 6개 지역에 재선거 소청을 제기하기로 한 데 대해 “다분히 정략적인 이용”이라고 비판했다.)

An election appeal is an administrative adjudication process that requests a correction from a higher election commission before filing a lawsuit when there is a dispute over local election results. It must be filed within 14 days after election day, and the election commission must make a decision within 60 days of receipt. If the appeal is upheld, a re-election is held within 30 days from the date of the decision notice. (선거 소청은 지방선거 결과에 이의가 있을 때 소송을 제기하기 전 상급 선거관리위원회에 시정을 요구하는 행정심판 절차다. 선거일 뒤 14일 이내 제기해야 하며, 선관위는 접수 뒤 60일 안에 결정해야 한다. 소청이 인용되면 결정 통지일로부터 30일 이내 재선거가 치러진다.)

In a statement distributed to the Seoul press corps on the 16th, Mayor Oh said, "Even if any citizen watches this, they would suspect it’s not for a pure intention," adding, "It’s a highly political exploitation, reflecting an awareness of the current shaky leadership within the party and its weak internal position. Many people seem to be evaluating it that way." (오 시장은 16일 서울시 출입기자단에 배포한 입장문에서 “국민 어떤 분이 지켜봐도 순수한 의도는 아니라는 짐작을 하고 계실 것”이라며 “지금 당내의 흔들리는 리더십, 당내의 빈약한 입지를 의식한 다분히 정략적인 이용이다. 많은 분이 그렇게 평가하고 있는 것으로 보인다”고 밝혔다.)

Mayor Oh also pointed out flaws in the decision-making process. He stated, "For an issue of this magnitude, it should have been preceded by a general meeting of lawmakers to gather consensus, but the problem is that the leadership unilaterally made the decision," and "The floor leader holds a different opinion. If there’s no unified opinion even within the leadership, then there’s a problem with the decision-making process." (오 시장은 의사결정 과정에도 문제가 있다고 지적했다. 그는 “이 정도 중차대한 사안인 경우에는 의원총회를 거쳐 총의를 모으는 게 선행돼야 될 사안인데 일방적으로 지도부에서 결정한 게 문제”라며 “원내대표는 의견을 좀 달리하고 계신다. 지도부 내에서도 통일된 의견이 아니라면 의사결정 과정에 문제가 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 15th, the leadership of the PPP, led by Jang Dong-hyuk, held an emergency Supreme Council meeting and decided to file election appeals in six regions: Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, and Gwangju/Jeonnam. The party explained that the decision had to be made urgently, as the deadline for appeals expires on the 17th. (앞서 국민의힘 장동혁 지도부는 15일 긴급 최고위원회를 열고 서울·경기·인천·부산·울산·광주전남 등 6개 지역에서 선거소청 제기를 결정했다. 당 쪽은 소청 기한이 오는 17일 마감되는 만큼 “급하게 결정해야 했다”고 설명했다.)

Reporter Shin Hyeong-cheol newiron@hani.co.kr (신형철 기자 newiron@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Agree to Parliamentary Investigation of Election Commission... To Be Processed at Plenary Session on the 18th (여야, 선관위 국정조사 합의…18일 본회의 처리)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party agreed on the 16th to a "parliamentary investigation to uncover the truth behind violations of political rights, such as the shortage of ballots, and to reform election management" (tentative name). The chair of the special parliamentary investigation committee will be held by the People Power Party. The ruling and opposition parties plan to process the parliamentary investigation plan at the National Assembly plenary session on the 18th. (더불어민주당과 국민의힘이 16일 ‘투표용지 부족 사태 등 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사’(가칭)에 합의했다. 국정조사특위 위원장은 국민의힘이 맡기로 했다. 여야는 오는 18일 국회 본회의에서 국정조사계획서를 처리할 계획이다.)

Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's senior deputy floor leader, and Kim Seung-su, the People Power Party's senior deputy floor leader, met twice at the National Assembly that day and agreed to the "parliamentary investigation into the Election Commission." The subjects of the investigation are the National Election Commission and all levels of election commissions. The investigation period is 45 days, and it can be extended if additional investigation is needed. ( 천준호 민주당 원내수석부대표와 김승수 국민의힘 원내수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 두 차례 회동하고 ‘선관위 국정조사’에 합의했다. 국정조사 대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회와 각급 선관위다. 조사 기간은 45일이고, 추가 조사가 필요하면 연장할 수 있다.)

After the meeting, Senior Deputy Floor Leader Cheon told reporters, "We agreed to the parliamentary investigation to swiftly uncover the truth about the infringement of citizens' political rights and to prepare legislation for a comprehensive reform of the Election Commission." Senior Deputy Floor Leader Kim said, "Since the Ministry of the Interior and Safety is also involved in the incident, the two parties have agreed to actively cooperate in selecting witnesses, including the Minister of the Interior and Safety, related officials, and public officials from cities, counties, and districts where the ballot shortage occurred." ( 천 수석부대표는 회동 뒤 기자들과 만나 “국민 참정권 침해 상황에 대한 진상을 조속히 규명하고 선관위를 대대적으로 개혁할 수 있는 법안을 마련하는 차원에서 국정조사에 합의했다”고 말했다. 김 수석부대표는 “행정안전부도 (사태에) 관련이 돼 있어서 증인 신청에 있어 행안부 장관과 공무원들, 그리고 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 시·군·구 관계 공무원 증인 채택에 (양당이) 적극 협조하기로 합의했다”고 말했다.)

The members of the special parliamentary investigation committee will be equally divided between the ruling and opposition parties, following National Assembly customs. There will be 9 members from the Democratic Party, 7 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-negotiating groups. The allocation of members from non-negotiating groups will be decided by the National Assembly Speaker. ( 국조특위 위원은 국회 관례대로 여야 동수로 하기로 했다. 민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 비교섭단체 2명이다. 비교섭단체 위원 배분은 국회의장이 결정한다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Proposes Two-Stage Election Commission Reform…“Install Internal Independent Audit Body, then Constitutional Amendment” (민주, 2단계 선관위 개혁 제시…“내부 독립 감사기구 설치 뒤 개헌 ”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has proposed a "two-stage reform plan" for the National Election Commission, which caused the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections. The core content involves organizational renewal through the establishment of an independent internal audit body and a reorganization of the Election Commission system via constitutional amendment. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 초래한 중앙선거관리위원회에 대한 ‘2단계 개혁안’을 제시했다. 내부 독립 감사기구 설치 등을 통한 조직 쇄신과 개헌을 통한 선관위 체제 개편이 핵심 내용이다.)

Kim Young-bae, a lawmaker who serves as the deputy head of the Democratic Party's "Task Force for Institutional Reform to Protect Citizens' Suffrage," outlined the direction of Election Commission reform during the second meeting of the task force on the 16th, stating, "I will present a two-stage plan for reforming election management by the Election Commission." (민주당 ‘국민참정권 수호를 위한 제도개혁 티에프(TF)’ 부단장을 맡은 김영배 의원은 16일 티에프 2차 회의에서 “저는 2단계 선관위 선거관리 개혁 방안을 제시하겠다”며 선관위 개혁 방향에 대한 구상을 밝혔다.)

Deputy Head Kim said, "We must push forward first-stage reforms through legislation in this year's regular parliamentary session, including introducing a system for a standing Chairman of the Election Commission, expanding standing commissioners, and enacting a bill to establish an independent audit body within the Election Commission," and added, "Regarding the constitutional amendment issue, including specifying the Board of Audit and Inspection's authority to audit the Election Commission, we should pursue it as a second stage early next year." (김 부단장은 “선거관리위원장의 상임 제도를 도입하고, 상임위원을 확대하는 것과 함께 선관위 내부에 독립적 감사기구를 설치하는 법안 등 입법을 통한 개혁을 올해 정기국회까지 1단계로 추진해야 한다”며 “(이후) 감사원의 (선관위) 감사 제도 명시를 비롯한 개헌 문제에 대해서는 내년 초 2단계로 추진해야 한다”고 했다.)

The Task Force for Electoral System Reform is an internal party body launched by the Democratic Party on the 10th. After discussing the framework of the reform plan at the second meeting, it plans to hold a related forum on the 17th. (선거제도 개혁 티에프는 민주당이 지난 10일 발족한 당내 기구다. 이날 2차 회의에서 개혁안 얼개를 논의한 뒤 17일 관련 토론회를 열 계획이다.)

item.title: KMA Alumni Association Opposes Hasty Integration of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies (육사 총동창회 “육·해·공군사관학교 졸속 통합 반대”)
item.description:
The Alumni Association of the Korea Military Academy (KMA) expressed "deep concern over the weakening of national security that would result from the hasty push to integrate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies," demanding a complete review of the integration plan from scratch. (육군사관학교(육사) 총동창회가 “육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 졸속 추진이 가져올 국가 안보 약화에 깊은 우려를 표한다”며 3군 사관학교 통합을 원점에서 재검토하라고 요구했다.)

In a statement distributed to the media on the 16th, the KMA Alumni Association said the Ministry of National Defense is pushing forward a policy to establish a "National Defense Academy" (tentative name) that would jointly select cadets from the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, provide common education for freshmen and sophomores, and allow juniors and seniors to choose their service branch for specialized education. The association stated, "Training elite officers for battlefields evolving into high-tech warfare is a critical matter directly linked to national survival, yet the Ministry of National Defense is unilaterally and hastily pushing forward the integration of the academies without objective research, military academic validation, or serious communication with experts." It argued that integrating the academies would limit the cultivation of identity and expertise in officer training, ultimately weakening combat capability. (육사 총동창회는 16일 언론에 배포한 입장문에서 국방부가 ‘국군사관학교'(가칭)를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하고, 1·2학년엔 공통 교육을, 3·4학년엔 군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 하는 사관학교 통합 정책을 추진하고 있다고 밝혔다. 육사 총동창회는 “첨단과학기술전으로 진화하는 전장에서 정예 장교 양성은 국가 생존과 직결된 중대사인데 국방부는 객관적인 연구나 군사학적 검증, 전문가와 진지한 소통이 없는 채 일방적이고 졸속으로 사관학교 통폐합을 추진하고 있다”고 했다. 총동창회는 사관학교가 통합될 경우 장교 양성에서 정체성과 전문성 함양이 제한되고, 이는 결국 전투력 약화로 이어질 수 있다고 주장했다.)

The association reported that the Ministry of National Defense is actively considering relocating the KMA from its current location in Taereung, Nowon-gu, Seoul to Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla Province. The area in Jangseong-gun houses the Sangmudae complex, which includes five Army branch schools such as the Army Infantry School, and there is idle land owned by the Ministry near there, prompting the proposed relocation. (총동창회는 현재 서울 노원구 태릉에 있는 육사를 전남 장성군으로 이전하는 방안이 국방부 내에서 유력하게 검토되고 있다고 전했다. 장성군에는 육군보병학교 등 5개 육군 병과학교가 모인 상무대가 있는데, 상무대 근처에 국방부 소유 유휴지가 있어 이곳으로 육사 이전이 추진되고 있다는 것이다.)

The association argued, "If the KMA moves to Jangseong, it could lead to a qualitative decline in the educational foundation, including restrictions on attracting top talent and faculty and diverse educational exchanges." In response, the Ministry of National Defense explained, "The relocation of the KMA to Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla Province, has not been confirmed yet." (총동창회는 “육사가 장성으로 이전할 경우 우수 인재·교수 유치와 다양한 교육 교류에 제한이 되는 등 교육 기반의 질적 저하를 초래할 수 있다”고 주장했다. 이에 대해 국방부는 “육사 전남 장성군 이전은 현재 확정되지 않았다”고 설명했다.)

While acknowledging that "some negative actions by officers from certain military academies in the past are very regrettable," they insisted, "The integration should not be pushed through hastily without in-depth expert verification and public consensus." (이들은 “과거 일부 사관학교 출신 장교들의 부정적 행적은 매우 유감스러운 일”이라면서도 “전문가들의 심도 있는 검증과 국민적 공감대 없이 졸속으로 통합이 추진돼서는 안 된다”고 주장했다.)

The "Citizens' Solidarity for Protecting the Future of National Defense," composed of KMA cadet parents, also issued a statement on the same day, stating, "Since (the integration of military academies and the relocation of the KMA) is a critical issue that shakes the foundation of national security and the framework for training elite officers, prior review and social consensus must come first." The group argued, "Above all, the voices of cadets and military personnel, who are the direct stakeholders and potential victims of the policy, should be given absolute priority." (육사 생도 학부모 등으로 꾸려진 ‘국방의 미래를 지키는 시민연대’도 이날 성명을 내어 “(사관학교 통폐합과 육사 이전은) 국가안보의 근간이자 정예 장교 양성 체계의 틀을 흔드는 중대한 사안인 만큼, 사전 검토와 사회적 합의가 선행되어야 한다”고 밝혔다. 이 단체는 “무엇보다 정책의 직접적인 이해 당사자이자 피해자가 될 수 있는 생도와 군 구성원들의 목소리가 절대적으로 우선 반영되어야 마땅하다”고 주장했다.)

Regarding questions about the integration of military academies at a regular briefing on the same day, Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Jeong Bit-na said, "We are not using the term 'integration,' and the plan to establish a National Defense Academy has not been finalized yet," adding, "There is consensus on the need for reform measures to train future elite officers, so we are developing specific plans to further specialize each service branch's expertise and create an overall premier educational institution." (정빛나 국방부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 사관학교 통폐합 관련 질문에 대해 “통폐합이란 용어는 저희가 사용하고 있지 않고, 국군사관학교 창설 방안이 아직 확정되지 않았다”며 “미래정예장교 양성을 위해서 개혁 방안이 필요하다는 것에는 공감대가 있어서, 각 군 전문성을 더 특화하고 전체적인 명품 교육기관을 창설하기 위한 구체적인 방안을 마련하고 있다”고 말했다)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Ministry Recruiting UNESCO Official from North Korea for Jeju Forum (외교부, ‘제주포럼’에 북한 출신 유네스코 인사 섭외 중)
item.description:
The international academic conference "Jeju Forum," scheduled to take place on Jeju Island from the 24th to the 26th, is recruiting a North Korean official to participate, drawing attention to whether it will be realized. The Jeju Forum, launched by Jeju City in 2001, is co-hosted this year with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. (오는 24~26일 제주에서 열리는 국제학술회의 ‘제주포럼’ 쪽이 북한 인사의 참여를 섭외하고 있어 성사 여부에 관심이 모인다. ‘제주포럼’은 2001년 제주시가 출범한 국제학술회의로 올해 행사는 외교부와 공동 주최한다.)

According to a summary of explanations from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Unification on the 16th, the Jeju Forum side is pursuing the recruitment of Dr. Jang Gwang-cheol, the Head of the Education Policy Section in the Policy and Lifelong Education Division at UNESCO Headquarters. A Unification Ministry official met with reporters that day and stated, "The organizing side of the (Jeju Forum) reported contact with a North Korean resident, and (the Ministry of Unification) accepted it." (16일 외교부와 통일부 설명을 종합하면, 제주포럼 쪽은 유네스코 본부 정책·평생교육국 교육정책 부서장인 장광철 박사 섭외를 추진하고 있다. 통일부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “(제주포럼) 주최 쪽에서 북한 주민접촉신고를 했고, (통일부가) 이를 수리했다”고 밝혔다.)

If Dr. Jang's recruitment succeeds, he will virtually participate in the session "UNESCO and the Future of Education: Challenges and Prospects" on the final day, the 26th, becoming the first North Korean official to attend the Jeju Forum. Additionally, it could serve as an example of inter-Korean exchange within the framework of an international event since North Korea defined inter-Korean relations as "hostile two-state relations." There is also a precedent last month when a North Korean hometown women's football team visited the South and played an international match in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province. (장 박사 섭외가 성사될 경우, 마지막날인 26일 ‘유네스코와 교육의 미래: 도전 및 전망’ 세션에 화상으로 참여하게 되고, 제주포럼에 참석하는 첫 북한 인사가 된다. 또, 북한이 남북관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가’ 관계로 정의한 이래 국제 행사의 틀 안에서 남북이 교류하는 사례가 될 수 있다. 지난달 북한 내고향여자축구단이 방남해 경기 수원에서 국제경기를 치른 선례도 있다.)

However, the Unification Ministry official added, "It has not yet been determined whether (Dr. Jang) will attend, and we will have to wait and see." So far, no notification of a change in participants has been reported from the UNESCO side. (다만 통일부 당국자는 “(장 박사가) 참석할지는 아직 정해지지 않았고, 지켜봐야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 현재까지 유네스코 쪽에서 참석자 변경 통보는 없는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Dr. Jang is an education expert with a diverse career at UNESCO. He served as Acting Head of the UNESCO Office for West Africa and the Sahel, and as a Senior Programme Specialist at the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Regional Bureau for Education and the UNESCO Office in Dakar. At UNESCO Headquarters, he developed various educational programs, including education rights and policy analysis, as well as early childhood care and education. Before joining UNESCO, he worked at the North Korean Ministry of Education. He earned his Ph.D. in education from Kim Hyong Jik University of Education in North Korea. (장 박사는 유네스코에서 다양한 경력을 쌓은 교육 전문가다. 유네스코 서아프리카와 사헬 지역사무소 소장 대행, 유네스코 아시아·태평양 교육지역사무국과 다카르 사무소에서 선임 프로그램 전문가 등으로 활동했다. 유네스코 본부에서는 교육권과 교육 정책 분석, 영유아 보육과 교육 등 다양한 교육 프로그램을 개발했다. 유네스코에 합류하기 전엔 북한 교육성에서 일했다. 그는 북한 김형직사범대학에서 교육학 박사학위를 받았다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Noh Geon-ho: "Yoo Si-min, a Valuable Intellectual... Also Aware of Kwak Sang-eon's Concerns" (노건호 “유시민, 귀중한 지식인…곽상언 문제의식도 인지”)
item.description:
Noh Geon-ho, the son of the late former President Roh Moo-hyun, issued a statement regarding author Yoo Si-min, who recently stepped down as standing advisor to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, stating that "Regardless of political alignment or personal preferences, he deserves respect and high regard as a valuable intellectual." (고 노무현 전 대통령의 아들 노건호씨가 최근 노무현재단 상임고문직을 내려놓은 유시민 작가에 대해 “정치적 노선이나 개인적 호불호를 떠나 귀중한 지식인으로 존중받고 높게 평가받는 것이 마땅하다”는 입장을 냈다.)

In a statement released on the 15th, Noh said about Yoo, "I believe that his role in drawing the attention of (Roh Moo-hyun Foundation) members and citizens and leading intellectual yet accessible discussions is a contribution to the foundation and a social contribution that others cannot easily replace." ( 노씨는 지난 15일 낸 입장문에서 유 작가에 대해 “(노무현재단) 회원들과 시민들의 관심을 모으고 지적이면서도 접근 가능한 담론들을 이끌어 주신 데 대해서도, 다른 이들이 쉽게 대체할 수 없는 재단에 대한 기여이자 사회적 공헌으로 생각하고 있다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

Earlier on the 12th, Kwak Sang-eon, a member of the Democratic Party of Korea and son-in-law of the late President Roh, pointed out on his YouTube channel that "Out of 2,010 videos on the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation's YouTube channel, only 360 are related to former President Roh, yet Yoo appears in 68% of all videos." He also mentioned the recent live broadcast of Yoo's book launch event on the foundation's YouTube channel, saying, "I'm not sure who the foundation's YouTube channel and website are actually promoting. If a bakery doesn't sell bread but promotes the baker, it's a promotion agency, not a bakery." <<> In response, Yoo Si-min issued a statement on the 15th saying, "I requested the foundation to remove me from my post as standing advisor. This is to prevent any potential difficulties the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation might face in the future due to the critical activities I will undertake," and the foundation accepted his request for removal as standing advisor. <<> Noh wrote, "Representative Kwak's remarks and judgments are entirely his own, and it is not a matter for me to step in and intervene. However, I am fully aware of the long-held thoughts and concerns that Representative Kwak has." He added, "Although we are now witnessing some tumultuous and unpleasant conflicts, the essence of politics has always been a struggle for power, and all of this will pass. What matters is what remains after a sandstorm passes. I ask you to firmly hold the flag and stay with the foundation." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 앞서 지난 12일 노 전 대통령의 사위인 곽상언 더불어민주당 의원은 자신의 유튜브 채널에서 ‘노무현재단 유튜브 채널 동영상 2010개 가운데 노 전 대통령 관련 콘텐츠는 360개에 그치지만, 전체 영상의 68%에 유 작가가 등장한다’고 지적했다. 또 최근 노무현재단 유튜브 채널에서 유 작가의 출판기념회를 생중계한 점 등도 언급하며 “노무현재단의 유튜브·홈페이지가 실질적으로 누구를 홍보한다고 봐야 하는지 모르겠다. 제과점이 빵을 팔지 않고 빵 만드는 사장을 홍보한다면 이건 홍보업체지 제과점이 아니다”라고 했다. )

item.title: People Power's Han Ji-ah Criticizes 'Jang Dong-hyuk for Seeking Consent from Illegal Polling Station Protesters and Negotiating' (국힘 한지아 “장동혁, 불법 개표소 시위대 동의 구하고 협상” 비판)
item.description:
Han Ji-ah, a lawmaker of the People Power Party, criticized party leader Jang Dong-hyuk over his mediation between employees of sports organizations attempting to enter their office inside the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Seoul and protesters blocking the polling station, stating that 'rather than resolving the illegality, he sought the consent of the protesters and negotiated.' <<> In a Facebook post on the same day, Han said, 'Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho stated that private interrogations, facility occupations, and access controls are clearly illegal. What was confirmed at the Olympic Park was the disappearance of the rule of law and police authority,' adding, 'What is even harder to understand is the behavior of leader Jang.' <<> Han criticized, 'Leader Jang did not resolve the illegality but rather sought the consent of the protesters and negotiated. Even the employees of the sports organizations entering their own office was left to the permission of the protesters. South Korea is a country governed by the rule of law. It is not a country where protesters decide who can enter, and politicians mediate this.' Han added, 'Leveraging public anger, another illegality should not be tolerated.' <<> Employees of sports organizations affiliated with the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee, who have been blocked from entering the building for 12 days, attempted to enter the handball gymnasium again starting the morning, but the protesters reacted with shouts and intense emotions, citing 'the possibility of removing ballot boxes and ballots.' After negotiations with the protesters and People Power Party lawmakers including leader Jang, the employees accepted conditions including: △ placing two broadcast cameras capable of live streaming △ allowing entry by two people per organization in turns △ conducting bag checks upon exiting the building. <<> However, with one participant wearing a Star-Spangled Banner around their waist clinging to the door handle, the employees' entry into the office ultimately failed. On-site, leader Jang, holding a megaphone, said, 'One person is currently blocking the entrance. It's not a situation where we can enter,' adding, 'If even one person is blocking that door, I have no intention of forcing this today.' <<> The police launched an investigation into the protesters who prevented the employees from entering the office on the same day, on charges of obstructing business, among others. The Songpa Police Station stated, 'We will immediately begin an investigation based on the evidence and strictly handle legal proceedings.' <<> Reporter Kwang-jun Jeon light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 16일 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 안에 있는 사무실에 진입하려는 체육단체 직원들과 ‘개표소 봉쇄’ 시위대 간 협의를 중재한 것을 두고 한지아 국민의힘 의원이 “불법을 해소한 것이 아니라 시위대의 동의를 구하고 협상했다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: 45-Day National Audit of Election Commission…Ruling Party to Head Special Committee (‘선관위 국정조사’ 45일간 실시…특위위원장은 국힘서 맡기로)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party agreed on the 16th to conduct a national audit tentatively titled “Investigation into the Infringement of Citizens’ Voting Rights, Such as the Ballot Paper Shortage Incident, and Reform of Election Management.” (더불어민주당과 국민의힘이 16일 ‘투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상 규명 및 선거 관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사’(가칭)에 합의했다.)

Chun Jun-ho (Democratic Party) and Kim Seung-su (People Power Party), senior deputy chiefs of the National Assembly’s floor leaders’ office, held two meetings at the parliament that day and agreed to present a plan for the national audit concerning the “ballot paper shortage incident” that occurred during the June 3 local elections to the plenary session on the 18th for approval. Chun told reporters, “We agreed to the national audit to promptly uncover the truth behind the infringement of citizens’ voting rights and to prepare legislation that can comprehensively reform the National Election Commission.” Kim added, “The Ministry of the Interior and Safety is also involved in the situation, so regarding witness requests, we agreed that both parties would actively cooperate in selecting the Minister of the Interior and Safety, public officials, and relevant public officials from cities, counties, and districts where the ballot paper shortage occurred as witnesses.” (천준호(민주당)·김승수(국민의힘) 원내운영수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 두차례 만난 뒤 6·3 지방선거 당시 벌어진 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’에 대한 국정조사계획서를 오는 18일 본회의에서 처리하기로 합의했다. 천 수석부대표는 기자들에게 “국민 참정권 침해 상황에 대한 진상을 조속히 규명하고 선거관리위원회를 대대적으로 개혁할 수 있는 법안을 마련하는 차원에서 국정조사에 합의했다”고 밝혔다. 김 수석부대표는 “행정안전부도 (사태에) 관련이 돼 있어서, 증인 신청에 있어 행안부 장관과 공무원들, 그리고 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 시·군·구 관계 공무원 증인 채택에 (양당이) 적극적으로 협조하기로 합의했다”고 말했다.)

The agencies subject to the national audit are the National Election Commission and election commissions at all levels. The investigation period is 45 days, and it can be extended if additional investigation is needed. The chairperson of the Special Committee on the National Audit will be from the People Power Party. The committee will consist of an equal number of members from the ruling and opposition parties (9 vs. 9), following National Assembly convention: 9 from the Democratic Party, 7 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-bargaining groups. The allocation of seats for non-bargaining groups will be decided by the National Assembly Speaker. (국정조사 대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회와 각급 선관위다. 조사 기간은 45일이고, 추가 조사가 필요하면 기간을 늘릴 수 있다. 국정조사 특별위원회 위원장은 국민의힘이 맡기로 했다. 국조특위 위원은 국회 관례대로 여야 동수(9 대 9)로 하기로 했다. 민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 비교섭단체 2명이다. 비교섭단체 위원 배분은 국회의장이 정한다.)

Meanwhile, at a meeting of the Democratic Party’s Task Force (TF) for “Protecting Citizens’ Voting Rights and Institutional Reform” held that day, a “two-stage reform plan” for the National Election Commission was proposed. Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Young-bae, who serves as the TF deputy head, stated, “In the first stage, we should pursue legislative reforms by the regular session of the National Assembly this year, including introducing a permanent chairperson system for the Election Commission, expanding standing members, and establishing an independent audit body within the Election Commission.” He added, “Regarding constitutional amendments, including explicitly stipulating the Board of Audit and Inspection’s authority to audit the Election Commission, these should be pursued in the second stage early next year.” In response, TF member Lee Joo-hee said, “Starting with a discussion forum on the 17th to hear experts’ opinions, we will intensively prepare institutional improvement measures by the next meeting,” and indicated that Kim’s proposed two-stage reform plan “can be positively considered.” (한편 이날 민주당 ‘국민 참정권 수호를 위한 제도개혁 태스크포스(TF)’ 회의에서는 선관위에 대한 ‘2단계 개혁안’ 제안이 나왔다. 티에프 부단장을 맡은 김영배 민주당 의원은 “선관위원장 상임 제도를 도입하고 상임위원을 확대하는 것과 함께, 선관위 내부에 독립적 감사 기구를 설치하는 법안 등 입법을 통한 개혁을 올해 정기국회까지 1단계로 추진해야 한다”며 “감사원의 (선관위) 감사 제도 명시를 비롯한 개헌 문제에 대해서는 내년 초 2단계로 추진해야 한다”고 했다. 이에 대해 티에프 위원인 이주희 의원은 “17일 전문가들의 의견을 듣는 토론회를 시작으로 다음 회의까지 집중적으로 제도 개선 방안을 마련할 것”이라며 김 의원이 제안한 2단계 개혁안도 “충분히 긍정적으로 검토할 수 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae says "The party's owners are its members"... Lowering posture while showing intent to run in party convention (정청래 “당의 주인은 당원”…몸 낮추면서도 전대 출마 의지)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who faces calls to resign and not run due to responsibility for the June 3 local elections, emphasized the Democratic Party's historical legitimacy stretching from Kim Dae-jung to Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung on the 16th, stating, "The party's owners are its members." Regarding Jung's repeated emphasis on member sovereignty, observers inside and outside the party interpret this as an indirect expression of his intent to run in the party convention. (6·3 지방선거 책임론으로 대표직 사퇴 및 불출마 요구를 받는 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 16일 ‘김대중-노무현-문재인-이재명’으로 이어지는 민주당의 역사적 정통성을 강조하며 “당의 주인은 당원”이라고 했다. 정 대표가 당원 주권론을 거듭 부각한 것에 대해 당 안팎에서는 전당대회 출마 의지를 우회적으로 드러낸 것이라는 해석이 나온다.)

At the Central Committee meeting held at the National Assembly on the 16th, Representative Jung said, "Until the people's sovereignty government was born, there was the blood and sweat of countless people who supported Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in," adding, "We must use the history of Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in as nourishment to further flourish the history of Lee Jae-myung." Jung then quoted President Lee Jae-myung's remark that "Politics seems to be done by politicians, but in the end, it is done by the people," and added, "Party operations also seem to be done by the party leader, but ultimately, it is done by the party members." Furthermore, Jung emphasized the importance of the "one-member-one-vote system for delegates and rights-bearing members," stating, "History has seen many people shed blood to obtain the right to vote with one person, one vote, based on universality, equality, directness, and secrecy." <<> After sparking controversy on the 10th with the remark, "The people are eternal, and governments are short-lived," Representative Jung has been lowering his posture while minimizing confrontation with President Lee. On this day as well, he said, "I ask for generous applause and support for President Lee, who spares no effort on the diplomatic front." <<> Meanwhile, the emphasis on 'member-centeredness' is interpreted as an appeal for support and unity from party members, ultimately expressing his intent to run in the party convention. The fact that Jung has been notably highlighting the one-member-one-vote system, which party members support, reinforces this interpretation. The one-member-one-vote system equalizes the voting value of delegates and rights-bearing members in elections for the party leader and supreme council members, and Jung previously pushed this through despite internal opposition. A party leadership official said, "Representative Jung appears to have the will to run." <<> Within the party, it is seen that around the 18th, when President Lee returns from his European tour, will be a watershed moment for Jung's decision on whether to run in the party convention. Rep. Han Min-soo, Jung's chief of staff, said on SBS radio on this day, "Would the ruling party leader publicly discuss his own position during the president's overseas visit? I don't think he will do that." This implies that even if Jung states his position, it will be after President Lee's return. President Lee did not call Jung before departing for Europe on the 9th, and attention is focused on whether he will invite Jung to the homecoming event. A multi-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "For the sake of Representative Jung, the Democratic Party, and the president alike, the controversy should be resolved at least by this week." <<> Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and Rep. Song Young-gil, mentioned as potential contenders for party leadership, attended a workshop for elected members of the Democratic Party-affiliated South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City council members held in Boseong, South Jeolla, on this day. Honam is a region where one-third of rights-bearing members are concentrated, and this move is seen as targeting the hearts of Honam voters in the party convention. <<> Meanwhile, observations suggest that author Yoo Si-min, who stepped down as a standing advisor to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation on the 15th, may provide indirect support for Representative Jung in the party leadership race. Regarding his resignation from the standing advisor role, Yoo stated, "It is to prevent any potential difficulties the foundation might face due to my future critical activities." Another multi-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "He seems to have the will to play a direct role in the current conflict situation." <<> Reported by Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 정 대표는 16일 국회에서 열린 중앙위원회의에서 “국민주권정부가 탄생할 때까지 김대중·노무현·문재인 대통령을 지지했던 수많은 사람들의 피와 땀이 있었다”며 “우리는 김대중·노무현·문재인의 역사를 자양분 삼아 이재명의 역사를 더욱 꽃피워야 한다”고 했다. 정 대표는 이어 ‘정치는 정치인이 하는 것 같지만 결국은 국민이 한다’는 이재명 대통령의 발언을 인용하며 “당 운영도 당대표가 하는 것 같지만 결국 당원이 한다”고 덧붙였다. 아울러 정 대표는 “역사는 보통·평등·직접·비밀의 1인 1표 투표권을 얻기 위해 수많은 사람이 피를 흘렸다”며 ‘대의원-권리당원 1인 1표제’의 중요성을 강조했다.)

item.title: 'Maldives and Kota Kinabalu business trips' by the National Election Commission...Noh Tae-ak spent 84 million won on one trip (몰디브·코타키나발루 ‘선관위 출장’…노태악 ‘1회 8400만원’ 지출)
item.description:
Amid public outcry over the National Election Commission's (NEC) poor election management, highlighted by the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections, it has been confirmed that over the past five years, NEC employees have made 107 overseas trips involving 461 personnel. Some of the destinations included popular resort spots such as the Maldives and Kota Kinabalu. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 중앙선거관리위원회의 부실한 선거 관리가 사회적 질타를 받는 가운데, 최근 5년간 선관위 직원들이 지난 5년간 107회에 걸쳐 461명이 국외 출장을 다녀온 것으로 확인됐다. 출장지 중에는 대표적 휴양지로 꼽히는 몰디브·코타키나발루 등도 있었다.)

According to the 'Status of NEC Employees' Overseas Trips Over the Past Five Years' received by People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun on the 16th, NEC employees took a total of 107 overseas trips from 2022 to June of this year. The trips involved 461 people, with a total budget of 2.45255 billion won. By year, there were 29 trips (815.8 million won) in 2022, 30 trips (690.15 million won) in 2023, 20 trips (346.21 million won) in 2024, 26 trips (581.28 million won) in 2025, and 2 trips (33.31 million won) this year. (김기현 국민의힘 의원이 16일 중앙선거관리위원회에서 받은 ‘최근 5년간 선관위 직원 국외출장 현황’을 보면, 2022년부터 올해 6월까지 선관위 직원들은 총 107차례 국외 출장을 떠났다. 출장 인원은 461명, 총 소요 예산은 24억5255만원이었다. 연도별로는 2022년 29건(8억158만원), 2023년 30건(6억9015만 원), 2024년 20건(3억4621만 원), 2025년 26건(5억8128만원), 올해는 2건(3331만원)의 국외 출장이 이뤄졌다.)

The destinations included major resort areas such as the Maldives, Thailand, Malaysia, and Kota Kinabalu. (출장지 중에는 몰디브, 타이, 말레이시아, 코타키나발루 등 대표적 휴양지가 포함됐다.)

Lawmaker Kim's office reported that a trip in September 2023, under the guise of observing the Maldives presidential election, cost about 14.7 million won for five employees. Another trip in November of the same year, cited as a check on the readiness for overseas voting, sent five staff to Thailand, Malaysia, and Kota Kinabalu, using approximately 19.2 million won in budget. (김 의원실은 2023년 9월 몰디브 대선 참관 명목으로 직원 5명이 다녀온 출장에는 약 1470만원이 투입됐고, 같은 해 11월 재외선거 준비 상황 점검을 이유로 타이·말레이시아·코타키나발루를 방문한 출장에는 5명이 약 1920만원의 예산을 사용했다.)

Some destinations were visited repeatedly for the same purpose. In 2022, 10 employees traveled to Florence and Milan, Italy for the purpose of "capacity building," spending about 30 million won. The following year, in 2023, nine employees visited Florence and Venice for the same reason, also spending about 30 million won. In 2025, five employees again went to Florence for the same purpose, spending 22.9 million won. Lawmaker Kim claimed that the 2022 Italy training trip report even included visits to historical and cultural sites like the Duomo Cathedral, the Uffizi Gallery, and the Vatican. <<>= A trip last November, aimed at studying poor election management cases in Germany, cost about 19.7 million won for four people. Another trip in November of the same year to Denmark and Sweden, accompanied by former NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak, required a budget of about 84 million won. (동일한 목적으로 같은 지역을 반복적으로 가기도 했다. 2022년 직원 역량 강화 목적으로 이탈리아 피렌체·밀라노 등에 간 10명이 약 3000만원을 사용했는데, 다음 해인 2023년에도 9명이 같은 목적으로 피렌체·베네치아 등을 방문하는 데 약 3000만원을 썼다. 2025년에도 같은 목적으로 5명이 피렌체를 방문하는 데 2290만원을 사용했다. 특히 2022년 이탈리아 연수 결과보고서에는 두오모 대성당, 우피치 미술관, 바티칸 등 역사·문화 탐방 내용이 포함됐다고 김 의원은 주장했다.)

The trip reports submitted afterward were also lacking. A report from a trip last year, where six employees spent 13 million won to analyze Japan's postal and onboard voting systems, contained only general remarks: "It was confirmed that while the election systems of Japan and Korea are similar in broad terms, there are differences in operational methods due to political and cultural environmental differences." The 2022 Germany training trip report included a note: "We saw that the tragic historical sites in each city are well preserved." (지난해 11월 독일의 선거관리 부실사례를 공부하겠다고 떠난 출장에는 총 4명이 약 1970만 원을 사용했고, 사퇴한 노태악 전 위원장이 동행한 지난해 11월 덴마크·스웨덴 출장에는 약 8400만 원의 예산이 들어갔다.)

Lawmaker Kim said, "The NEC has been criticized for poor elections and incompetence for years, but even their overseas trips have been conducted poorly," adding, "At this point, it's no exaggeration to call it not just a 'dream job' but a divine one. Thoroughly investigate these cases of budget waste to assign responsibility." (출장 뒤 제출된 결과보고서도 부실했다. 지난해 일본의 우편·선상투표 제도 분석을 위해 6명이 1300만원을 들여 다녀온 출장 결과보고서에는 “일본과 한국의 선거제도는 큰 틀에서는 비슷하면서도 정치적·문화적 환경 차이로 운영방식에 차이점이 있음을 확인했다”는 원론적인 내용이 쓰였다. 2022년 독일 연수 결과보고서에는 “각 도시에서 벌어진 비극적인 역사의 현장도 잘 보존하고 있음을 알 수 있었다”는 내용이 기재됐다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (김 의원은 “선관위가 수년 전부터 이미 부실선거와 무능으로 질타받고 있었지만, 정작 선관위는 해외 출장마저 부실하게 다녀온 것”이라며 “이쯤 되면 ‘신의 직장’이 아니라 신 그 자체라고 해도 과언이 아니다. 예산 낭비 사례를 철저히 조사해 책임소재를 가려내야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Government begins communication with US and Iran over Hormuz Strait passage… "Opposed to tolls" (정부, 미·이란 상대 호르무즈 통항 소통 시작…“통행료 반대”)
item.description:
Following the US-Iran agreement to end hostilities, the government has initiated communication with the US and Iran to facilitate the passage of South Korean vessels stranded in the Hormuz Strait. However, with thousands of ships anchored in the strait, safely extracting our vessels in the near future is expected to be no easy task. (미국과 이란의 종전 합의에 정부가 호르무즈해협에 발이 묶인 우리 선박들의 통항을 위해 미국·이란과 소통에 나섰다. 다만 수천여 척의 배가 해협에 정박 중인 상황에서 이른 시일 안에 우리 선박을 안전하게 빼내는 일은 만만치 않을 전망이다.)

Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Park Il stated at a regular briefing on the 16th, "The government is aware of the detailed circumstances regarding vessel passage and has begun necessary communication with relevant countries, including the US and Iran," adding, "To assess the feasibility of passage, we need a comprehensive consideration of various factors, such as the overall security situation in the strait, including the presence of mines, the speed of the strait's opening, and available routes." (박일 외교부 대변인은 16일 정례브리핑에서 “정부는 선박 통항과 관련된 상세 내용을 파악하고 있으며, 이를 위해 미국·이란 등 관련국과 필요한 소통을 시작했다”며 “통항 (가능성을) 판단하기 위해서는 기뢰 유무 등 해협의 전반적인 안전 상황, 해협의 개방 속도, 이용 가능한 항로 등 여러 사항에 대한 종합적인 고려가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

Amid conflicting positions between the US and Iran over imposing passage tolls in the strait, the government has maintained its stance that such tolls are unacceptable. Spokesperson Park said, "The freedom of safe passage through the Hormuz Strait, an international waterway, must be fully guaranteed," and emphasized, "We hold the fundamental position that no passage fees or charges should be imposed." While the US has indicated that the strait could be used freely without tolls, Iran's Revolutionary Guard has reportedly suggested that a 'fee' will be charged 60 days after the cessation of hostilities. (해협 통항료 부과를 두고 미국과 이란의 입장이 상반되는 가운데 정부는 이를 인정할 수 없다는 입장을 유지했다. 박 대변인은 “국제 해협인 호르무즈해협의 안전한 통항의 자유가 전면 보장돼야 한다”며 “어떠한 통항료, 수수료도 부과되지 않아야 한다는 기본 입장을 갖고 있다”고 말했다. 미국은 통행료 부과 없이 호르무즈해협을 자유롭게 이용할 수 있을 거라는 입장이지만, 이란 혁명수비대는 종전 이후 60일이 지나면 ‘수수료’를 받을 것이라는 이야기가 나오고 있다.)

Beyond the toll issue, various variables must be examined, including the status and safety of available routes after the conflict ends, and the possibility of mine clearance operations. In particular, it remains uncertain whether all South Korean vessels can exit within the 60-day period stipulated by Iran. A Foreign Ministry official said on the same day, "Once the US and Iran sign the memorandum of understanding on the 19th, we need to see how quickly the strait will open, so it's difficult to say right now when our ships will be able to leave," adding, "Wouldn't all countries, including ours, be trying to get their vessels out within those 60 days?" Currently, 24 South Korean ships and 137 South Korean crew members remain in the Hormuz Strait. (통항료 문제 외에도 종전 이후 이용할 수 있는 항로 상황과 안전 여부, 기뢰 제거 작업 가능성 등 여러 변수를 살펴야 한다. 특히 이란이 제시한 60일 이내에 우리 선박들이 모두 나올 수 있을지도 미지수다. 외교부 당국자는 이날 “오는 19일 (미·이란이) 양해각서에 서명하면 해협이 어느 정도나 빠르게 개방될지를 봐야 하기 때문에 지금은 언제 우리 선박이 빠져나갈 수 있을지 말하기 어렵다”며 “우리뿐 아니라 모든 나라들의 (선박이) 60일 이내에 나오려고 하지 않겠느냐”고 말했다. 호르무즈해협에 우리 선박은 24척, 한국인 선원은 137명이 남아있다.)

Following the agreement to end hostilities, foreign media reports suggest that South Korea may participate in a US-led fund for Iran's reconstruction. However, it has been reported that no specific proposal regarding reconstruction projects has yet been received by the government from the US. Spokesperson Park stated, "We view the reconstruction fund as an issue raised within the framework of US-Iran negotiations, and the specifics will depend on the outcome of those talks," adding, "Our country will play a constructive role in the reconstruction process in the Middle East." (종전 합의 이후엔 미국이 주도하는 이란 재건 기금 조성에 한국이 참여할 수 있다는 외신 보도가 나오고 있지만 현재까지 정부 차원에서 미국으로부터 재건 사업 관련 제안을 받은 바는 없는 것으로 전해졌다. 박 대변인은 “재건 기금은 미-이란의 협상 틀 속에서 제기되는 사안으로 생각하고 있고, 구체적인 것은 협상 결과를 지켜봐야 한다”며 “우리나라는 중동 지역의 재건 과정에 건설적인 역할을 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)
